response: Delayed gastric emptying (DGE) following pancreaticoduodenectomy (PPPD) does not appear to be directly related to pylorus preservation. According to the available data, DGE after PPPD seems to be of minor clinical importance following uncomplicated surgery, and its occurrence is more closely linked to the presence of other postoperative complications rather than to the preservation of the pylorus. Additionally, the use of antecolic duodenojejunostomy may be a key factor in reducing the incidence of DGE after PPPD. Therefore, it can be concluded that pylorus preservation is not the primary factor contributing to delayed gastric emptying in this context.
